applicableAreas: Underground electric equipment throughout site
findings.comment: Sheet 21 shows underground electric lines and pull boxes throughout the site, but Sheet 31 (Landscape Plan) does not depict transformer pad locations, pull boxes, or underground line routing. Tree clearances from underground equipment cannot be verified without coordinated utility information on the landscape plan.

applicableAreas: Underground electric equipment 5-20 feet from proposed trees
findings.comment: Underground equipment locations from Sheet 21 are not coordinated on Sheet 31 landscape plan. Root barrier requirements cannot be verified without showing underground facilities on the landscape plan.

applicableAreas: Areas where root barriers would be required near underground equipment
findings.comment: Sheet 37 (Landscape Details) shows general tree planting details but does not provide UCM-specific root barrier specifications (minimum 4 feet deep, positioned exactly 5 feet from underground electric equipment edge) required for compliance.

applicableAreas: Underground electric duct banks and conduits
findings.comment: Underground electric conduit and duct bank routing shown on Sheet 21 is not depicted on Sheet 31 (Landscape Plan). Direct overlap of trees with underground duct banks cannot be verified without coordinated utility routing on landscape plan.

applicableAreas: Areas where tree wells would be proposed near underground utilities
findings.comment: Underground electric utility locations from Sheet 21 are not shown on landscape plans. Tree well placement relative to underground electric equipment, duct banks, or guy wire posts cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: All three pad-mounted transformer locations
findings.comment: Sheet 21 shows three pad-mounted transformers on the site (northwest, east, and southwest locations). Sheet 31 (Landscape Plan) does not depict any transformer pad locations or indicate required 10-foot clearances from trees. Electrical utilities must be coordinated on landscape plans to verify clearance compliance.

applicableAreas: Area within 15 feet of overhead electric line along western and southern property boundaries
findings.comment: Sheet 21 shows overhead electric (OHE) line on western boundary with utility poles. Sheet 31 shows trees along southern perimeter where OHE line exists. However, proposed tree species utility-compatible (UC) designation cannot be verified—no cross-reference to ECM Appendix F UC column shown on landscape plans. Clearance distances also not dimensionally verified.

applicableAreas: Areas within 25 feet of overhead electric distribution line
findings.comment: Mature height of proposed tree species (Cedar Elm, Live Oak, Mexican Redbud, Texas Mountain Laurel) not verified against ECM Appendix F mature height column. Cannot determine if any proposed species are large trees (≥40 feet mature height) requiring 25-foot clearance from overhead distribution.

applicableAreas: Electric transmission easement if present
findings.comment: A 5' Electric Easement is shown on Sheet 2 along the southern property boundary. Trees are proposed along this same southern boundary (Sheet 31). However, the designation of this easement as transmission (≥60kV phase-to-phase) vs. distribution (<60kV) cannot be determined from available plans. No voltage information provided to confirm whether this is a transmission easement subject to blanket no-trees restriction.

applicableAreas: Area within 50 feet of overhead electric transmission line if transmission facilities present
findings.comment: No transmission facilities confirmed. Overhead electric (OHE) line voltage class (transmission ≥60kV vs. distribution <60kV) not specified on plans. Proposed species UC designation not verified against ECM Appendix F.

applicableAreas: Area within 50 feet of overhead transmission if present
findings.comment: Transmission facilities not confirmed. Mature height of proposed species not verified against ECM Appendix F to determine if any are large trees (≥40 feet).

applicableAreas: Electric easement along southern property boundary
findings.comment: Trees are proposed along the southern property boundary where the 5' Electric Easement is located. No evidence of required license agreement from Austin Energy Public Involvement is provided. No plan note stating 'License Agreement obtained from Austin Energy' appears on any sheets. License agreement documentation must be verified before certificate of occupancy.

applicableAreas: Trees within electric easement along southern property boundary
findings.comment: Trees are shown positioned along the southern property boundary where the 5' Electric Easement exists. Specific positioning relative to the easement outer edge versus center cannot be confirmed from available plan information. Detailed easement dimensions and tree locations relative to access corridors not provided.

applicableAreas: Area within 10 feet of utility poles along western property boundary
findings.comment: Sheet 21 shows three utility poles along the overhead electric line on the western property boundary. Sheet 31 (Landscape Plan) does not show pole locations or depict required 10-foot clearances. Utility poles are not coordinated on landscape plan.

applicableAreas: Access door sides of pad-mounted transformers
findings.comment: Transformer pad locations and access door orientations from Sheet 21 are not shown on landscape plan. Shrub clearances from pad-mounted equipment access door sides cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Non-access sides of pad-mounted transformers
findings.comment: Transformer pad locations and equipment orientations are not depicted on landscape plan. Shrub placement on non-access sides cannot be verified without coordinated equipment information.

applicableAreas: Areas around subsurface electric vaults or manholes
findings.comment: Sheet 21 shows a 'Vault Easement' in the southwest area, but specific vault/manhole locations are not depicted on the landscape plan. Shrub placement relative to vault access requirements cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Between transformer access doors and drivable surfaces
findings.comment: Transformer pad orientations, access door directions, and drivable surface locations are not shown on landscape plan. Tree placement relative to bucket truck access zones cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Access routes and equipment setup areas for transformers
findings.comment: Transformer locations from Sheet 21 are not coordinated on landscape plan. Tree locations relative to transformer access routes, turning radii, and equipment setup areas cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: In front of electric vaults
findings.comment: Vault locations shown on Sheet 21 are not depicted on landscape plan. Tree placement and mature canopy spread relative to vault access cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Trees within 10 feet of electric easement edge, southern property boundary
findings.comment: Trees are proposed along the southern property boundary where the 5' Electric Easement is located. Mature canopy spread circles are shown on the landscape plan, but the specific relationship between canopy overhang and the easement boundary cannot be precisely determined from available plan dimensions. Detailed analysis of mature canopy spread extending into the easement corridor is required.

applicableAreas: All electrical facilities and all landscape areas
findings.comment: Sheet 21 (Preliminary Electrical Design Plan) shows three pad-mounted transformer pads, six pull boxes, underground electric line routing, utility poles, and vault easement. None of these electrical facilities are depicted or referenced on Sheet 31 (Landscape Plan). Coordination of utilities on landscape plans is essential for verification of clearance compliance and access requirements.

applicableAreas: All proposed landscaping near electrical facilities
findings.comment: No Austin Energy written approval documentation found on any landscape or electrical plans. No approval letter, email, plan note signed by Austin Energy, or Austin Energy Design approval stamp is visible. Any variation from UCM § 1.10.10.4 clearance requirements or ECM Appendix F species restrictions requires explicit written Austin Energy approval.

applicableAreas: All proposed tree and shrub planting areas
findings.comment: Proposed species include Cedar Elm, Live Oak, Mexican Redbud, Texas Mountain Laurel, Dwarf Palmetto, Big Muhly, Gulf Muhly, Texas Sage, Dwarf Wax Myrtle, and others. No cross-reference to ECM Appendix F is provided on landscape plans. Utility-compatible (UC) designation for any proposed species is not documented. Species proposed near overhead electric lines (OHE) along southern boundary must be verified against ECM Appendix F UC column before approval.
